method.center: volume-weighted absorber centroid (the auto pulse centre)
method.h_proxy: regular-tetrahedron edge length with the same element volume: (6*sqrt(2)*V)^(1/3), micrometres

assessment.evidence: The >350 um region has nearly the same volume fraction in both meshes (~74%), but its median h proxy decreases from 33.93 to 17.91 um and its tetrahedron count rises from 60,218 to 596,530. The Ball did not remain local in the final mesh.
assessment.interpretation: The enabled MeshSizeExtendFromBoundary is evidence-supported as the first setting to isolate in the next experiment. MeshSizeFromPoints is also enabled, but this diagnostic alone does not isolate its contribution; MeshSizeFromCurvature is already disabled.

next_experiment_proposal.smallest_change: Use absorber local size 25e-6 m and radius 75e-6 m, while disabling only Mesh.MeshSizeExtendFromBoundary for the absorber-Ball experiment; retain MeshSizeFromPoints and MeshSizeFromCurvature settings initially.
next_experiment_proposal.rationale: The current 16.7 um / 150 um Ball produced 943,968 total volume elements because its small size reached the outer absorber. A 25 um / 75 um Ball lowers the requested refinement ratio and refined volume. Disabling boundary extension is directly motivated by the observed global spread and the locally confirmed default value of 1.
next_experiment_proposal.guardrail: Preflight and stop after mesh validation if total volume elements are not below 250000; do not run ElmerSolver until that condition and radial-locality checks pass.
